question: What procedures are set forth in the twenty-first chapter?
premises: The twenty-first chapter includes the rite concerning the dead and the living and the net.
It includes instruction in the levels and a group of consecratory rites.
It also includes an investigation of strength and weakness.
inference: The twenty-first chapter sets forth these rites and investigations as its procedure.
uncertainties: The technical meaning of jāla and padeśa is compressed in this summary verse.
plain_english: In the twenty-first chapter, the procedure will cover the rite of the dead and the living, the net, instruction in the levels, the group of consecrations, and the investigation of strength and weakness.
